lines.en: I trudge along with my club.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌把地面踩得闷响
lines.en: My feet thud against the ground.

lines.zh: 我从这一头巡到那一头
lines.en: I patrol from one end to the other.
I duck under the doorway.
I take two steps and pause to listen.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤颜色像烧过的土
lines.en: My skin is the colour of scorched earth.
I shift into the shade.
My chains rattle as I walk.
I have been on this level a long time.

lines.zh: 我拖着棒子走，地上一道痕
lines.en: I drag my club, leaving a groove.
I circle the stone dais once.
I lumber off to another spot.
I stand like a rock.
I scratch the horn on my head.
I have stared at the brazier a while.
I scratch the horn on my head.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸把火苗吹歪了
lines.en: My breath bends the flame.
I wait; someone always comes.
I switch my club to the other hand.
I hum a tuneless song.
I lean on a pillar to rest.
I crack my knuckles.

lines.zh: 活人怎么走到这一层来了
lines.en: How did a living one reach this level?
You carry the warmth of the living.

lines.zh: 你要问路，还是来交任务
lines.en: Are you here for directions or for work?
Let me see if you measure up.
Stand back, I am covered in ash.
I know that look.
Do not tremble, I do not eat people.

lines.zh: 你要办的事，我这儿有一桩
lines.en: I have a job that might suit you.
I have to look down to see you.
Good timing, I was idle.

lines.zh: 我皮厚，这一下不算什么
lines.en: My hide is thick; that was nothing.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出一声闷哼
lines.en: A grunt rolls out of my throat.
I step back and the floor shakes.
Who was it that struck me?
It hurts, but I am still standing.
I brush the ash off.

lines.zh: 皮糙肉厚，可这回真的疼。
lines.en: Thick hide, but this one truly stings.
My brow furrows.
My grip on the club tightens.
Do not do that a second time.

lines.zh: 这东西在我们这儿不管用
lines.en: That does nothing down here.
Take that back with you.
I eat other things.
The underworld has no such flavour.
You brought food down here?
I am not a greedy one.
If I am hungry, I go find my own.

lines.zh: 你举着那点东西做什么
lines.en: Why are you holding that little thing up?
Thanks, but no.
Put it away and let us talk business.
You walked into my leg.

lines.zh: 我这身板，撞一下不碍事
lines.en: This body shrugs off a bump.
Mind my club.
Do not crowd, the door is narrow.
I turn sideways to let you pass.
I step back to clear the way.
The floor is slick, walk carefully.

lines.zh: 站远点，我正忙着记名册。
lines.en: Stand back, I'm busy with the roll call.

lines.zh: 我是守门的，不是成家的
lines.en: I keep the gate, I do not keep a household.
That is rare in the underworld.
My errand is not finished.

lines.zh: 我只想把手里的活干完
lines.en: I just want this work done.
Who would want someone like me?
Enough, let us talk about the task.
I cannot bring myself to say such things.
Take care of your own business first.
I have stood here for centuries.
I shake my head slowly.
If it drops, pick it up.
This should not lie about.
I bend down, slowly.
I set it on the dais.
Whose is this? I will keep it.
I am not your servant.
It is too hot to hold.
I pick it up and look.
Do not expect me to deliver it.
Leave it here, not on the floor.
I have my eye on you. Keep still.

lines.zh: 你走这层，得先过我这关
lines.en: To pass this level you deal with me.
I lift my club, then lower it.
Let me see what you carry.
Something in your ki is off.
I take a step and the floor shakes.
Do not think you can slip past me.
I know that kind of footstep.
You speak first; I am listening.
I lay my club across the path.
You do not look like a troublemaker.
I have your position fixed.

lines.zh: 我这么站着，你敢不敢过来
lines.en: Standing like this, will you dare approach?
Let me explain this level's rules.
I raise a hand for you to stop.
I watch your hands without blinking.
Every step you take, I mark.
I will not strike, and neither will you.
I turn slowly, following you.
I can hear your breathing.
I block the door; you are not leaving.
I shoulder my club again.
Think it through before you move.
There is no other way on this level.
Reach for it and I will know.
I am waiting for you to speak plainly.

lines.zh: 我脚下的影子比你的长
lines.en: My shadow is longer than yours.
You may look away, I will not.

lines.zh: 我守了几百年，不差这一会儿
lines.en: I have guarded for centuries; a moment more means nothing.
Come closer and my hand comes up.
I clear half the path.
I say this once.

lines.zh: 我的石棒横在你胸前，停住了。
lines.en: My stone club stops across your chest.
That was only a shove.
I held back, do not fear.
My club strikes the ground.
The stone cracks under it.
Back away, my hands are heavy.
I push you to the wall without hurting you.

lines.zh: 这一下是提醒，不是杀招
lines.en: That was a warning, not a killing blow.
Are you standing steady?

lines.zh: 我的力气在这儿不好收
lines.en: My strength is hard to hold back here.
I lift you up and set you down.
Do not provoke me twice.
The floor dents under my foot.
Strike again and I stop being gentle.
On this level, I decide.

lines.zh: 我从冥界的门后走出来
lines.en: I step out from behind the gate of the underworld.
I watch over this level.
The brazier light falls on my face.
Walking this far took nerve.
I wait here for errands.
I plant myself, club on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这里的空气你该不习惯
lines.en: You are probably not used to this air.
I open my eyes slowly.
Another pair of prints on the steps.
Few living ones take this road.
I sort out my chains.
I have kept this door for centuries.

lines.zh: 我的影子把火盆挡住了
lines.en: My shadow covers the brazier.
I might have work for you.

lines.zh: 这火跟冥界的火不一样
lines.en: This fire is not like the fires below.
I roll down the stone stairs.
I choke on water, and it stings.
The blast slams me into the wall.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder.
Magic numbs my horn.

lines.zh: 我已经很久没吃东西了
lines.en: I have not eaten in a long while.

lines.zh: 雷落在这层，石柱都裂了
lines.en: Lightning falls here and the pillar splits.
The dais under me is gone.
